future_acceptance_gates.protocol_identity: parent protocol, corrected atlas, theta0, T, N, B, preconditioners, v, t interval, subdivision strategy, and precision match exactly
future_acceptance_gates.frame_rank: Arb certificate proves the response frame rank needed for the implicit graph setup
future_acceptance_gates.T_N_dimensions_and_transversality: Arb certificate proves T is 14x6, N is 14x8, and the chosen splitting is transverse on the full tube
future_acceptance_gates.B_strict_invertibility: fixed B has an Arb/Neumann inverse certificate with defect strictly less than one
future_acceptance_gates.preconditioner_defect: each fixed sub-tube preconditioner has an Arb defect strictly less than one
future_acceptance_gates.krawczyk_self_mapping: each sub-tube Krawczyk image is strictly contained in its declared normal box
future_acceptance_gates.krawczyk_contraction: each sub-tube interval Newton/Krawczyk contraction margin is strictly below the frozen threshold
future_acceptance_gates.graph_existence: strict implicit-function/Krawczyk theorem gives a graph branch on every leaf
future_acceptance_gates.graph_uniqueness: strict uniqueness holds on every leaf normal box
future_acceptance_gates.overlap_consistency: adjacent leaf graph branches overlap consistently on shared t intervals
future_acceptance_gates.chart_residence: theta(t) stays in the declared local chart and model domain
future_acceptance_gates.no_phase_wrap: no phase representative crosses a periodic wrap boundary
future_acceptance_gates.exact_response_identity_logic: H(t,psi(t))=0 plus strict B invertibility implies R_3(theta(t))=R_3(theta_0)
future_acceptance_gates.same_R3_cost_meter: future R5 uses exactly the parent R3/W_Pi protocol-relative response cost
future_acceptance_gates.zero_total_response_cost: zero cost follows only from the exact response identity, not from residual tolerance
future_acceptance_gates.nonconstant_positive_measure: on I=[0,1/12], prove cos(2*pi*s)>0, nonzero intrinsic speed, and environment speed lower bound
future_acceptance_gates.epsilon_shrinking_family: the five frozen epsilons are positive, ordered, and converge toward zero at the declared scale

nonconstancy_design.required_cosine_bound: future certificate must prove cos(2*pi*s) >= 1/2 on I=[0,1/12]
nonconstancy_design.environment_speed_gate: future certificate must lower-bound the graph embedding speed using a certified singular value or coordinate projection

required_logic: strict implicit graph existence and uniqueness on full tube
H(t,psi(t))=0 holds exactly by the implicit function theorem
